#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Official-function globals isolation and full-task ETA/token-plan checks. CPU only.
# Existing eval environment; no download, install, new environment, training or checkpoint.
# Required gates fail closed. Each phase owns fresh output and retains raw failures.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
PY=data_cache/p106b_official_eval_runtime/core6_env_20261023/bin/python
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 101 --name P106B_Stage8ag1W_qwen_extra_cpu -- timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=20s 180s "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m unittest -v scripts.test_p106b_qwen35_extra scripts.test_p106b_qwen35_extra_driver
